items.title: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong runs a chief-of-staff AI agent over a team of specialist agents
items.summary: Brian Armstrong described a setup where a chief-of-staff agent directs lead agents for coding, research and team ops, all feeding one prioritized review queue that still needs his sign-off.

items.title: METR: AI assistance nearly doubles Anthropic research iteration speed
items.summary: Evaluator METR reported that since late 2025 Anthropic's research iteration on key tasks sped up about 1.9x, largely from AI assistance inside the lab.

items.title: OpenCode Browse pairs a Chromium extension with an MCP server for on-device browser agents
items.summary: OpenCode's Browse lets agents drive background tabs in Chrome, Edge or Brave with your real logins through an MCP server, handing control back to you for logins, 2FA and payments.

items.title: Anthropic Claude Duet app can steer cloud Claude Code sessions from a phone
items.summary: Anthropic linked the Claude Duet mobile app to Claude Code cloud sessions so developers can check progress and approve changes from their phone on Pro, Max and Ultra plans.

items.title: Wolters Kluwer ships TyMetrix 360 MCP for governed legal agent workflows
items.summary: Wolters Kluwer launched a TyMetrix 360 MCP server so legal teams can create matters, adjust invoices and assign follow-ups inside their existing AI assistants under current permissions.

items.title: Vercel Labs agent-desktop 1.2.0 exposes desktop CLI commands as MCP tools
items.summary: Vercel Labs shipped agent-desktop 1.2.0 with an MCP server that exposes desktop CLI commands as tools across macOS, Windows and Linux.
